scope: Terra High, actual isolated Electron workbench, development build and in-memory model fixture

checks.name: Synthetic model stalled and teacher Stop persisted interrupted Task
Workbench double click created exactly one new Run and generation for the same Task
Visible response and terminal same-task state persisted without duplicate Run
Cold readback retains same Task and resumed Run with no replay

evidence.basedOnLocalFixture: Phase7 plain-test.mjs, built from existing native resume fixture

compoundFixture.actual: The fixture called plan update and file read in the same model response. The file read succeeded. The Task had no verified readback checks, so the draft was not delivered.

orderedRecoveryCounterexample.scenario: Issued the plan and safe read in separate model responses. The fixture still listed a read as a planned dependency, contrary to the current tool contract.

approvalResumeFinding.scenario: Real visible UI approved one exact synthetic filesystem operation. After stopping and continuing the same Task, the identical draft was blocked at the effect recheck.
approvalResumeFinding.expected: A known non-dispatched write can be attempted again only after the current permission gate authorizes it.
approvalResumeFinding.actual: First write was admitted to the Task, then returned permission_denied. The native effect was none; the stored effect was uncertain. The next Run failed task_effect_needs_recheck before delivery. Neither output file was created.
approvalResumeFinding.implementationTrace: tools/execution-bound.ts still has invoked=false when the native write is never called. tasks/task-state.ts priorEffect treats a prior cross-Run effectful admission as an unresolved write.
approvalResumeFinding.needed: Reconcile only trusted, fenced never-dispatched effects and retain the existing permission and actually-invoked effect fences. Then rerun file preservation and old-Run callbacks.
